videos.title: Joomla for beginners tutorial 1 - Introduction to joomla, download and install
videos.description: This video introduces Joomla, covering its core function, and demonstrates the download and installation process. It also outlines prerequisite resources for further tutorials.

videos.title: Joomla for beginners tutorial 3 - Creating an article
videos.description: This tutorial demonstrates creating and editing articles within Joomla 3.3, covering fundamental content management operations in the platform.
